use: Style evidence only; never copy phrases, facts, numbers or identity.
method: Roster weights normalized over available eligible donors; equal mass per donor post; sentence mass equal within post. UTC cadence over observed scrape interval. Signature lift is weighted cluster document frequency divided by unweighted eligible all-donor document frequency (3-word EN / 4-character ZH n-grams, present in at least 2 cluster posts).

qualitative.variation_notes: Length runs from a few words to multi-paragraph technical explanations, and the long-form posts tend to appear as threads. The register ranges from neutral, structured disclosure summaries to casual or profane reactions, self-deprecating asides and sardonic one-liners. Hooks are mostly direct claims. Questions, contrast pivots, quote-led openings and the occasional emoji banner add variety without dominating. Some donors post in both English and Chinese, and their structure stays the same across the two languages.
qualitative.judgment_style: Mostly assertive on direction, with data as the main support. About three quarters of posts lean on figures, disclosures or quotes. When the subject is a forecast, views are often hedged with conditions, scenario splits, time windows or limits on scope. Judgments tend to show up as a brief read-through after the evidence, such as which part of the supply chain benefits or whether a narrative holds, rather than as a standalone thesis. Strong, unhedged opinions appear mainly in short reactive or ironic posts.
